title: Leakage-aware classification of indoor air quality from low-cost sensors: code, configuration and results
description: Code, configuration file (config.yaml), data and results for the article 'Leakage-Aware Classification of CO2-Based Indoor Air Quality from Low-Cost Office Sensors: A Day-Wise Validated Comparison of Twelve Machine Learning Models' (Journal of Soft Computing and Data Mining). Twelve classifiers are evaluated under random, leave-one-day-out and chronological validation on the Occupancy Detection dataset (Candanedo & Feldheim, 2016; CC BY 4.0).
